name: azul_widgets_touch_tabs_select_and_the_panel_follows
description: The touch pills of the Tab looks section: twelve pills in a row that scrolls sideways, one selection, a panel under them. A click on a pill that is far to the right of the row (the row scrolls) selects it and the panel says so; the selected pill is the tab the panel names. The same file runs on a desktop and on a phone.

steps.text: A phone to try it on

name: azul_widgets_a_window_on_a_pixel_8_has_one_hole_in_the_middle_and_a_strip_around_it
description: The window made to sit on a Pixel 8 (a preset, on any platform): get_display_features says one circular cutout in the middle of the top edge, a 48 px status bar and the gesture bar; the page's top is then the touch strip in the status bar's band. Turning it off gives the window back what the platform reports.

steps.text: A phone to try it on

name: azul_widgets_a_window_on_an_iphone_with_the_island_has_a_pill_and_turns_it_on_its_side
description: The preset of an iPhone with the Dynamic Island, then the window turned to landscape: the pill is at the top in portrait and at the left edge on its side, and the insets move to the sides. A preset is a window flag, so the same ops run on a desktop and on a phone.
